review.title: Machine learning for siRNA efficiency prediction: A systematic review

entries.name: siRecords
entries.endpoint: Four ordinal experimental efficacy ratings
entries.notes: Table 2 is a snapshot, not a count of downloaded compatible duplexes. BiLTR used a filtered 19-nt labeled subset; no copy of that subset was retrieved. Preserve efficacy categories rather than fabricate numerical inhibition. Live original database tested overHTTP andHTTPS; both timed out.

entries.name: Katoh / Takayuki / Suzuki EGFP
entries.endpoint: Measured normalized EGFP knockdown activity; exclude separate Our prediction column
entries.notes: Verified 702 numerical activity rows in original Table S1. Original siRNAs generated from in-vitro transcribed shRNA by limited RNase T1 digestion into complete duplexes; not a shRNA expression assay. GNN FASTA remains SENSE despite mixed orientations in combined files.

entries.name: Amarzguioui / Prydz
entries.orientation: sense in table/meta-dataset; target cDNA in MG3
entries.endpoint: Experimental efficacy; binary class subset retrieved
entries.notes: MG3 contains 46 measured-classified sequences; do not claim the review/meta-dataset full Amarzguioui collection is downloadable from MG3. The full cross-platform download site timed out.

entries.name: Huesken / Novartis / BIOPREDsi
entries.endpoint: Measured inhibition; not ANN predicted scores
entries.notes: 2431 source rows independently verified in Ichihara and NCBI FTP. Use NatBio_Eff not Predicted_eff in FTP file and % Inhibition not model score columns in Ichihara. Training/test/downsized partitions and full genome-wide predicted library are not new measurements.

entries.name: Jagla / Sloan-Kettering
entries.orientation: sense in original paper; antisense in review Table 2/meta-dataset
entries.endpoint: Gene-specific normalized measured protein-level activity
entries.notes: Primary article is publicly readable but EuropePMC supplementary endpoint returns an XML not-open-access error despite HTTP200. It is NOT a valid ZIP. No complete sequence-efficacy source file retrieved.

entries.name: Shabalina thermodynamic/composition compendium
entries.endpoint: Activ = residual target expression percent of untreated control
entries.notes: 653 19-nt sequences with numerical Activ values verified; trailing dinucleotide-analysis rows are not samples. Per-row reference markers partition original studies; source strings retained in extracted CSV.

entries.name: Saetrom / Satron / Snove pooled data
entries.orientation: antisense according to review; Jia XLS orientation must retain source attribution
entries.endpoint: Experimental activity; Jia field named inhibitory activity but values may represent residual expression
entries.notes: Downloaded Jia Satron sheet has 561 valid sequence/numeric rows, not the review Table2 snapshot. Do not confuse 537, 561, 581, 579, or Wang280 subsets; no equality or full coverage is asserted.

entries.name: Amgen-Dharmacon / Reynolds
entries.orientation: antisense in compendium; sense in some original descriptions
entries.endpoint: Measured inhibition or residual activity, source-dependent
entries.notes: Reynolds-labeled rows exist in Ichihara; shared-author tags must also be retained. Review239, later240/244/248 and original180 denote different filtering/compilation variants and must not be assumed interchangeable.

entries.name: Vickers / Isis
entries.endpoint: Measured % inhibition in Ichihara
entries.notes: 76 rows explicitly labeled Vickers in Ichihara source verified. The original publication compares siRNAs and RNase-H antisense agents; do not import ASO arms as siRNA.

entries.name: Khvorova / Khovorova
entries.endpoint: Measured % inhibition
entries.notes: 10 rows labeled Khovorova verified; further shared labels exist and are not included in this count.

entries.name: Hsieh PI3K-pathway library
entries.endpoint: Residual target expression Activ
entries.notes: 103 Shabalina rows carry the publication reference NAR2004;32(3):893-901. This is a verified reused subset, not verified full108 dataset.

entries.name: Harborth (review spelling Haborth)
entries.endpoint: Measured % inhibition
entries.notes: 44 Harborth-labeled rows verified; cannot infer every duplex in the original sequence/chemical/structural variation paper is unmodified from base strings alone.

entries.name: Ui-Tei
entries.orientation: antisense in Ichihara; sense/target cDNA in MG2
entries.endpoint: Measured inhibition or measured binary class
entries.notes: 62 MG2 measured-classified sense/target sequences verified; numerical Ichihara source has 37 pure Ui-Tei tags plus3 shared Ui-Tei/Reynolds. Do not synthesize missing numerical efficacies for categorical MG2 rows.

entries.name: Ichihara / i-Score datasets A+B
entries.review_location: Refs17 and27; older data reused by siPRED
entries.orientation: Both explicit antisense21mer and sense19mer columns
entries.endpoint: % Inhibition measured, plus clearly separate predicted model scores
entries.notes: Partition A2431+B419 verified. All predicted columns must stay out of labels. Author and accession columns preserve origin.

entries.name: Ichihara new HEK293 pSELL/pDual validation
entries.review_location: Experimental validation in reviewed i-Score paper
entries.endpoint: Measured luciferase inhibition
entries.notes: Not 86 synthetic siRNA duplex drug assays: paper uses pDual vector to express interfering RNA and pSELL target vector. Keep construct provenance and do not silently admit to synthetic standard-complementary benchmark.

entries.name: Shabalina independent low-concentration validation
entries.endpoint: Activ residual expression percent
entries.notes: Two independent experiments at low concentration, not part of the653 training compendium. Source publication refs retained.

entries.name: Takasaki MG1-MG5 measured test collection
entries.endpoint: Effective/Ineffective classes from measured silencing
entries.notes: Verified per-sheet MG1=50, MG2=62, MG3=46, MG4=14, MG5=24. This is a measured test file, not the synthetic negative training set.

entries.name: Takasaki cyclin B1 measured MG4 collection
entries.review_location: Older test set reused by reviewed RBF work
entries.endpoint: Measured binary efficacy
entries.notes: MG4 contains7 effective and7 ineffective measured test examples. Do not duplicate separately if MG1-MG5 aggregate is loaded.

entries.name: Takasaki literature positives plus random negative training
entries.endpoint: Mixture of literature efficacies and empirically assumed random-sequence negative labels
entries.notes: Ref39 states860 effective literature siRNAs and860 randomly generated presumed ineffective sequences. No complete860-positive source file retrieved. Random negative sequences do not have measured labels.

entries.name: Peek corrected heterogeneous dataset579
entries.endpoint: Experimental activity with source sequences altered for target correspondence
entries.notes: Ref34 describes starting from a581 compilation, discarding2 and altering3 at1-2 positions. Do not attach original experimental labels to corrected sequences without preserving this distinction.

entries.name: Wang/Huang/Yang nonredundant280 benchmark
entries.endpoint: Measured residual mRNA level; binary cutoff
entries.notes: Ref47 provides assay counts and derives source from Saetrom2004, but no sequence-label supplementary file. No verified downloaded sample count.

entries.name: Wang/Applied Biosystems hyperfunctional-siRNA wet-lab validation
entries.endpoint: Measured remaining target expression at3nM and30nM
entries.notes: 140 design rows parsed,135 distinct guide/passenger pairs. Two measured concentrations per row. SupplementaryTable4 provides additional algorithm comparisons but no sequence identifiers in table; cannot invent missing sequences.

entries.name: Wang2009 additional algorithm-comparison assay
entries.endpoint: Remaining mRNA percent at two concentrations
entries.notes: Not a reusable sequence-efficacy collection until corresponding sequences are located.

entries.name: VIRsiRNApred quantitative viral-siRNA compendium
entries.orientation: 19nt; exact orientation not verified from downloaded rows
entries.endpoint: Experimental numeric viral inhibition
entries.notes: Paper combines VIRsiRNAdb,HIVsirDB,patents,and literature. TrainingT1380 and validationV345 are partitions, not new assays. Downloaded count is null; do not claim every public viral example was retrieved.

entries.name: VIRsiRNAdb
entries.review_location: Underlying sources explicitly named by reviewed VIRsiRNApred
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy subset, not every catalog entry
entries.notes: Bibliographic databases and patents are source collections, not proof that every entry has a compatible numeric efficacy label. This subset overlaps VIRsiRNApred.

entries.name: HIVsirDB
entries.review_location: Underlying sources explicitly named by reviewed VIRsiRNApred
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy subset, not every catalog entry
entries.notes: Bibliographic databases and patents are source collections, not proof that every entry has a compatible numeric efficacy label. This subset overlaps VIRsiRNApred.

entries.name: VIRsiRNApred patent-derived experimental sequences
entries.review_location: Underlying sources explicitly named by reviewed VIRsiRNApred
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy subset, not every catalog entry
entries.notes: Bibliographic databases and patents are source collections, not proof that every entry has a compatible numeric efficacy label. This subset overlaps VIRsiRNApred.

entries.name: VIRsiRNApred additional literature examples
entries.review_location: Underlying sources explicitly named by reviewed VIRsiRNApred
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy subset, not every catalog entry
entries.notes: Bibliographic databases and patents are source collections, not proof that every entry has a compatible numeric efficacy label. This subset overlaps VIRsiRNApred.

entries.name: siRNAdb
entries.review_location: Older pooled CNN data and GNN attempted reuse
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy
entries.notes: GNN2022 explicitly reports inability to recover siRNAdb. Archive repository verified contains README,JavaScript,Perl only, no dataset.

entries.name: Klingelhoefer/Liu cross-platform meta-dataset
entries.review_location: Older large meta-dataset reused in several models
entries.orientation: mixed original sense/antisense; standardized antisense in analysis
entries.endpoint: Continuous residual product levels except categorical siRecords
entries.notes: Contains Huesken,Jagla,Katoh,Amgen-Dharmacon,Harborth,Hsieh,Khvorova,Vickers,Ui-Tei,Amarzguioui. Ref67 claims all datasets downloadable from supplementary information, but available PMC supplements are feature-ranking documents; actual dataset link is separate and timed out.

entries.name: GNN4siRNA datasets1/2/3
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy numerical values as represented by reuse repository
entries.notes: Verified raw efficacy CSV3518 and source partitions2431 A,385 B,702 T. Includes3518 sequence IDs, not proof of3518 unique duplex sequences. Must reverse complement only T sense rows, not all rows.

entries.name: Han2018 pooled deep-architecture collection
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy
entries.notes: Huesken,Reynolds,Vickers,Harborth,Katoh,Ui-Tei,siRNAdb. No full pooled source file retrieved; do not equate GNN3518 with full Han collection.

entries.name: Holen additional siRNA compilation
entries.endpoint: Measured siRNA activity
entries.notes: Ladunga states Holen collection and Saetrom database also analyzed, but no corresponding sequence-efficacy file retrieved.

entries.name: Shmushkovich2018 cholesterol-conjugated self-deliverable training set
entries.endpoint: Measured dual-luciferase remaining reporter expression
entries.notes: 2primeOMe/2primeF,phosphorothioates,cholesterol; modified guide5prime base fixedU. Not standard unmodified complementary19-23paired siRNA.

entries.name: Monopoli2023 new four-gene measured validation
entries.orientation: 20nt target regions; guide reverse complement must respect fixed terminalU chemistry
entries.endpoint: Measured mean and SD of remaining reporter expression
entries.notes: 20 measured rows verified TableS3. Model confidence scores and predicted classes are not efficacy labels. FigureS19 describes fully modified sense/antisense scaffold and cholesterol, not the training15/20 scaffold.

entries.name: Industry-generated therapeutic siRNA efficacy data
entries.endpoint: Measured efficacy not publicly provided
entries.notes: Generic class, not a named downloaded dataset; no examples invented.

entries.name: Genome-wide predicted siRNA libraries and model-output candidates
entries.endpoint: Predicted activity or calculated design features only
entries.notes: Separate measured Huesken2431 and Shabalina653 from genome-wide ANN predictions,human-transcript candidate parameters,TREAT candidates,and OligoWalk ranking outputs.

entries.name: TREAT biological networks and structural/thermodynamic resources
entries.endpoint: GTEx/TCGA expression,PPI,TF networks,structure predictions,thermodynamic parameters
entries.notes: TREAT siRNA component is21nt sliding-window rule-based candidate design, not a new measured siRNA assay dataset. Review language describing random-walk design should not turn network data into efficacy labels.

entries.name: Katoh additional endogenous-gene validation and TRBP binding
entries.review_location: Older primary data behind Table2 Katoh reuse
entries.endpoint: Measured gene knockdown plotted in figures; separate TRBP binding endpoint
entries.notes: Original paper reports75 GAPDH and10 beta-catenin validation siRNAs; these are not extra downloadable702 TableS1 rows. No digitized label invention. TRBP diffusion/binding experiments are not knockdown efficacy labels.
